diagram_candidates.rationale: The algorithm has distinct Hessian, feasibility, one-cost recovery, multi-cost no-step, and backtracking branches; a branch map could make its control flow easier to scan.
diagram_candidates.draw_or_check: Connect the positive-definite-Hessian check to the constrained quadratic program. Show feasible and infeasible branches; the infeasible branch uses the recovery proposal only for one constraint and returns no-step for multiple constraints. Then show the finite backtracking loop and its KL plus sample-cost acceptance checks. Label sample checks separately from exact-policy guarantees.
diagram_candidates.status: Optional; the procedure is completely specified in prose and equations.

diagram_candidates.rationale: The row routine transfers mass between ordered states inside an L1 confidence radius, then selects an action attaining the maximum backed-up value.
diagram_candidates.draw_or_check: Illustrate the lowest-value source state losing mass and the highest-value destination state gaining mass, with constraints from available mass, destination capacity, and remaining radius budget. Distinguish the row maximum from the subsequent first-maximizer action tie-break.
diagram_candidates.status: Optional; the routine and tie-breaking behavior are explicit in the definition.

diagram_candidates.rationale: The proof’s large-diameter construction combines a routing tree, paired bad/good states, and a distinguished useful state-action pair; a diagram could make the construction easier to follow.
diagram_candidates.draw_or_check: For the D≥16 branch, show bad and optional bare routing states in the rooted b-ary tree, each bad state paired with a good state, and useful actions moving from bad to paired good with probability p (or p+e at the distinguished pair) and otherwise staying. Keep the D<16 direct-transition/self-loop-reward construction separate if represented.
diagram_candidates.status: Optional; the proof gives the state/action counts, routing, probabilities, and branch conditions.

existing_diagram_checks.review: The rendered tree shows root action a_0 and two observation-labelled branches x,y ending at continuation actions a_x,a_y. This matches the prose; outgoing edges represent observations, including branch availability independent of a belief-specific zero likelihood. The diagram is small but readable and does not carry the algebraic procedure.

optional_typography.observation: KaTeX math rendered without receipt errors; no literal TeX/TikZ leakage or confirmed title notation issue. Apparent missing leading characters in multi-image tool output were viewer presentation artifacts; individual original tiles show the full title and text.
